layout.note: All 20 sources are placed once, in order: 66 output rows, 60 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 45 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. 8 inserted spaces across 4 original row boundaries are decided separately above, each accepted as the minimal correction where a boundary cut a sentence. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
